results.title: The Lagos
results.overview: Tomás and Agustín are dedicated to different healing disciplines: Tomás works in palliative care and Agustín in biodecoding. A trip to the south of Argentina, where Tomás will run 120 km and Agustín will photograph him, becomes an opportunity to heal their relationship and face their conflicts.

results.title: Racewalkers
results.overview: Will could never compete in the sport he’s always loved: racewalking. While struggling to find respect as a coach, Will’s fortunes change when he spots a burnout pitcher with the most impeccable racewalking stride he’s ever seen. Together, Will and Matt team up, face the challenges of a sport that doesn’t want them, and to try to take down the best walker in the country.

results.title: Bodacious
results.overview: On Halloween of 1986, two high schoolers collide and unite to defy expectations.

results.title: Vanish "The Bully Monster"
results.overview: Approached with this meaningful project about bullying, we knew we had to handle it with care. Our goal was to bring sensitivity and impact to the story. Back-to-school season is a time of fresh starts, and we wanted to spark important conversations for kids and families.

results.title: Shambles
results.overview: A fallen star. A broken home. A most regrettable evening.

results.title: Fest Godzilla II: Shinjuku Burning
results.original_title: フェス・ゴジラⅡ 新宿炎上
results.overview: Godzilla suddenly makes landfall from Tokyo Bay. The Self-Defense Forces begin their attack in Kabukicho, Shinjuku. However, during the battle, it is discovered that Godzilla’s body temperature is rising rapidly…!

results.title: Чувственный контакт
results.overview: Alexey Trantsev and Alexey Mutin lost their hands as a result of an electrical injury. Years later, they mastered bionic prostheses and live like ordinary people. Only they sorely lack the ability to feel with their hands — to feel warmth, cold, water, or touch their beloved girlfriend. Meanwhile, scientists are developing a system for sensing hand prostheses.

results.title: Fuori campo di Anna – Presentazione a Venezia, settembre 1975
results.original_title: Fuori campo di Anna – Presentazione a Venezia, settembre 1975
results.overview: After its premiere at the Berlinale Forum in February '75, Anna was also presented in Venice, the film was followed by a very well-participated debate, alongside Alberto Grifi there was Adriano Aprà, and among those present was Tatti Sanguineti, the author of a very articulate critical speech.  The footage of this meeting is part of the 30 cassettes containing the video footage from which the film was edited, thanks to the work of Anna Maria Licciardello, the Cineteca Nazionale with the Fondazione Grifi and the La camera ottica laboratory in Gorizia.

results.title: Hanna and the Forgotten Christmas
results.overview: Hanna and the monsters come home for their first Christmas, only for Gargoyle's interference to erase it from memory. They team up with a little monster, Esna, on a quest to find the missing Spirit of Christmas and prevent Gargoyle and Cyclops from seizing power and saving Christmas.

results.title: Hacked: A Double Entendre of Rage Fueled Karma
results.original_title: Hacked: A Double Entendre of Rage Fueled Karma
results.overview: Based on true events: The Rumble family’s dream of buying their first home turns into a nightmare when Florida’s most elusive hacker, known only as The Chameleon, steals their life savings. But this hacker messed with the wrong family. The banking system failed them. The police won’t help. Furious and desperate, they plot a revenge-fueled takedown of the hacker, determined to make him pay for every life he’s destroyed. What started as a financial tragedy soon spirals into a fast-paced, darkly comedic adventure to reclaim their money—and their dignity. Revenge has never been this fun!

results.title: Working Girls
results.overview: A humorous yet raw and authentic study of women’s reproductive labour across the marriage-market continuum, including, sex work, erotic dancing, surrogacy and egg donation, paid domestic work and unpaid domestic/care work across India, while also offering a comparison of the law’s highly differential regulation of these apparently disparate forms of female reproductive labour.

results.title: Waste Not
results.overview: Everyone does Thanksgiving a little differently, but when Andrew meets his girlfriend's parents for the first time, he realizes he might have a little difficulty in respecting their family traditions.

results.title: The Worst She Can Say
results.overview: Sylvester, a young man in his 20s, faces a challenge from friends that forces him to confront his fears and insecurities. Along the way, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery, learning to embrace his individuality, find peace in solitude, and appreciate the value of self-love and genuine connections.

results.title: Nang Mawalan ng Ilaw si Lolo Tacio
results.original_title: Nang Mawalan ng Ilaw si Lolo Tacio
results.overview: An isolating old man, haunted by the loss of his grandchild and unpaid bills, meets a child on an unlikely journey of warmth and rediscovery, all sparked by a power outage.

results.title: Anatomy Lab
results.overview: A group of college students in Idaho, celebrating the end of the school year, find themselves stalked by a viscous serial killer obsessed with female skin.

results.title: Laia
results.overview: Four unknown characters are summoned to a meeting with a great purpose: to create a flawless script. However, the combination won't be as successful as Laia had imagined.

results.title: Opry 100: A Live Celebration
results.overview: Blake Shelton hosts a star-studded celebration marking 100 years of the Grand Ole Opry, featuring performances from Ashley McBryde, Brad Paisley, Carly Pearce, Carrie Underwood, Clint Black, Dierks Bentley, Garth Brooks, Kelsea Ballerini, and Lainey Wilson.

results.title: Keys
results.overview: In the new one-man band experiment from filmmaker Kyle McCormick, a regular guy discovers a whole new way to express himself: home invasions.
